# Ryan-Rhys Griffiths

> Ryan-Rhys Griffiths is an AI research scientist in San Francisco working on reasoning models for mathematics and chemistry. PhD, University of Cambridge. Formerly Meta, Huawei Noah's Ark Lab and FutureHouse.
